tasks.label: Train DDP NVLink (Production)
args: export NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL && export NCCL_ALGO=Ring && export NCCL_PROTO=Simple && export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN && export TORCH_NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 && export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 && TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y_%m_%d_%H_%M_%S) && OUTPUT_DIR="${workspaceFolder}/outputs/py/ddp_nvlink_${TIMESTAMP}" && mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" && ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/torchrun --nproc_per_node=2 ${workspaceFolder}/main.py --input-path data --output-path "$OUTPUT_DIR" --num-train-pyramids 200 --batch-size 40 --num-workers 4 --num-iter 100 --num-parallel-scales 7 --discriminator-steps 3 --generator-steps 3 --alpha 10 --scale0-noise-amp 1.5 --min-noise-amp 0.3 --lambda-diversity 1.0 --use-wells --use-seismic 2>&1 | tee "$OUTPUT_DIR/train.log"

tasks.label: Benchmark NVLink - 2 GPU (global bs=40)
args: set -euo pipefail && export NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL && export NCCL_ALGO=Ring && export NCCL_PROTO=Simple && export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN && export TORCH_NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 && export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 && TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y_%m_%d_%H_%M_%S) && OUTPUT_DIR="${workspaceFolder}/outputs/bench/2gpu_bs40_${TIMESTAMP}" && mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" && ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/torchrun --nproc_per_node=2 ${workspaceFolder}/main.py --input-path data --output-path "$OUTPUT_DIR" --manual-seed 0 --num-train-pyramids 200 --batch-size 40 --num-workers 4 --num-iter 50 --num-parallel-scales 7 --discriminator-steps 3 --generator-steps 3 --alpha 10 --scale0-noise-amp 1.5 --min-noise-amp 0.3 --lambda-diversity 1.0 --use-wells --use-seismic --no-tensorboard --no-plot-outputs 2>&1 | tee "$OUTPUT_DIR/train.log"
